title: Contain a chargeback or fraud spike
summary: Most of this runs through your processor's APIs. Quantify the pattern. Tighten your fraud rules. Contest the disputes worth contesting; each card network has its own process and deadlines. Refund obvious fraud before it becomes a chargeback. A refund costs less than a lost dispute, and a sent refund cannot be undone, so refunds sit behind an approval step. The card networks' monitoring programs have thresholds with real consequences; watching them with your processor is the judgment part.

parts.title: Quantify the spike: dispute rate, affected charges, and the common pattern (BIN, geography, velocity)

execution.rationale: The authored work for “Quantify the spike: dispute rate, affected charges, and the common pattern (BIN, geography, velocity)” is preparation, analysis or editing of supplied records with text, file or code tools.
